summary: Natuzzi S.p.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting that it filed a Form 12b-25 regarding the late filing of its Annual Report on Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC action, or abrupt management change is disclosed. This is a routine notification of a late annual report, not a special situation. The filing provides no deal terms, advisor names, or board recommendations.
